source.author: lucr
source.text: denique Democritum post quam matura vetustas admonuit memores motus languescere mentis, sponte sua leto caput obvius optulit ipse.
source.text_original: denique Democritum post quam matura vetustas / admonuit memores motus languescere mentis, / sponte sua leto caput obvius optulit ipse.
source.text_english: Finally Democritus, after ripe old age warned him that the movements of the mind, though mindful, were growing weak, of his own accord himself offered his head as a willing victim to death.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam Democritus in alia fuit persuasione, sed tamen sponte sua leto caput obuius optulit ipse, quo nihil sceleratius fieri potest.
reuse.text_original: nam Democritus in alia fuit persuasione, sed tamen sponte sua leto caput obuius optulit ipse, quo nihil sceleratius fieri potest.
reuse.text_english: For Democritus held a different opinion; yet of his own accord he himself offered his head to death, a deed more wicked than which nothing can be done.
